def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    fill = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # Grid lines are the rows and columns that mostly differ from the tile fill.
    line_rows = [r for r in range(h)
                 if sum(v != fill for v in grid[r]) > w / 2]
    line_cols = [c for c in range(w)
                 if sum(grid[r][c] != fill for r in range(h)) > h / 2]

    if len(line_rows) < 2 or len(line_cols) < 2:
        return [[fill]]

    nodes = [[grid[r][c] for c in line_cols] for r in line_rows]
    separator = Counter(v for row in nodes for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    out = []
    active = []
    for i in range(len(line_rows) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(line_cols) - 1):
            corners = (nodes[i][j], nodes[i][j + 1],
                       nodes[i + 1][j], nodes[i + 1][j + 1])
            value = corners[0]
            marked = value != separator and all(v == value for v in corners)
            row.append(value if marked else fill)
            if marked:
                active.append((i, j))
        out.append(row)

    if not active:
        return out
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in active)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in active) + 1
    c0 = min(c for _, c in active)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in active) + 1
    return [row[c0:c1] for row in out[r0:r1]]

def transform(grid):

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    fill = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    rows = [r for r in range(h) if fill not in grid[r]]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != fill for r in range(h))]

    # Grid-line intersections encode the colors to place in the reduced grid.
    nodes = [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
    if len(nodes) < 2 or len(nodes[0]) < 2:
        return [[fill]]

    counts = Counter(v for row in nodes for v in row)
    common = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marks = {}
    for i in range(len(nodes) - 1):
        for j in range(len(nodes[0]) - 1):
            value = nodes[i][j]
            if (value != fill and value != common and
                nodes[i][j + 1] == value and
                nodes[i + 1][j] == value and
                nodes[i + 1][j + 1] == value):
                marks[(i, j)] = value

    if not marks:
        return [[fill]]
    r0 = min(i for i, j in marks)
    r1 = max(i for i, j in marks)
    c0 = min(j for i, j in marks)
    c1 = max(j for i, j in marks)

    for (i, j), value in marks.items():
        out[i - r0][j - c0] = value
    return out

    c0 = min(c for _, c in marked)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in marked) + 1
    return [line[c0:c1] for line in out[r0:r1]]

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # The repeated tile color forms many uniform 2x2 patches.
    scores = Counter()
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w - 1):
            a = grid[r][c]
            if a == grid[r][c + 1] == grid[r + 1][c] == grid[r + 1][c + 1]:
                scores[a] += 1
    tile = scores.most_common(1)[0][0]

    line_rows = [r for r in range(h) if tile not in grid[r]]
    line_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != tile for r in range(h))]

    out = []
    for i in range(len(line_rows) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(line_cols) - 1):
            a = grid[line_rows[i]][line_cols[j]]
            corners = (
                a,
                grid[line_rows[i]][line_cols[j + 1]],
                grid[line_rows[i + 1]][line_cols[j]],
                grid[line_rows[i + 1]][line_cols[j + 1]],
            )
            row.append(a if all(v == a for v in corners) else tile)
        out.append(row)

    marked = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(out)
              for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != tile]
    if not marked:
        return out or [[tile]]

    r0 = min(r for r, _ in marked)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in marked) + 1
    c0 = min(c for _, c in marked)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in marked) + 1
    return [row[c0:c1] for row in out[r0:r1]]
